top_signals.title: Baltic Pushed Brokers to Submit Rates During War, Court Told
top_signals.summary: A freight assessor at the Baltic Exchange told a broker that “a certain amount of cajoling and bullying” was necessary to get companies to provide tanker rates after the Iran war broke out.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
